status: Training/validation preparation for secondary direct horizon predictors; final test analysis remains unscored
representative_rule: Reuse the adjacent-calibration full-bundle representative rule with seed base plus source bucket. Sort exposures by bundle_index then immutable case_id before sampling one exposure per bundle.
origin_rule: Uniform within each user and declared fitting/validation calendar role, before future support or outcomes.
observed_cohort: H consecutive original timestamp bundles, including the origin, all within the same user's test role. No skipping excluded bundles or crossing user boundaries.
events: positive at least once through H
negative at least once through H
at least two positives through H
at least four positives through H
graph_transitions: 2*H-1 from a pending origin in the emission-aware decision lift
censoring_report: Selected, observed and unavailable origins and users, separately for every horizon and evaluation protocol. Do not count unavailable outcomes as negative.
weighting: Equal users within each supported observed-horizon cohort; report case-weighted descriptive sensitivity separately.
scope: Outcome-blind within-training/validation origin selection for direct horizon prediction heads. Only same-role observed future responses become fitting targets; no test-origin target export or final test scoring. Unseen-user fitting must additionally select the matching user role. Future contexts and outcomes are excluded from origin features.
execution: Prepare both roles in one pass per source bucket; no final evaluation.

resource_budget.scope: Smoke/full timeout and startup reservations; not provider-enforced billing cap
resource_budget.ledger: Existing human-cases allowance; no new ceiling
